name: Quarterly review template with limits
description: A deck template (template: true, filled by opf fill) whose variables say how much room they have: maxLength and maxLines on a text variable, maxItems on a list variable. The values here are within their limits, so the deck validates without warnings; a longer value is the warning opf/variable-overflow.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The one-line message of the cover. Keep it to a short sentence.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: Two sentences at most; the slide has room for three lines.
summary.value: Revenue grew 12 percent on the same quarter last year.

agenda.label: Agenda
agenda.description: Up to five topics, one per entry.
